acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS estimates GSCA with alternating least squares, permits standard or individual initial outer weights, and fixes the hidden maximum-iteration and stop settings at 3,000 and 10^-7.
acceptance_criteria: The setup supports standard and indicator-specific initial weights and records the permanent 3,000-iteration and 10^-7 stopping controls.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS sets every initial outer weight to +1 by default.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh GSCA setup initializes every outer weight to +1 and preserves any explicit indicator-level override.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: GSCA specifies weighted components from observed composite indicators and explicit structural paths, and accommodates reflective, formative, and mediation relationships.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover reflective and formative measurement plus a mediated structural relationship without silently converting components into common factors.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page refers to empirical data but does not freeze accepted input forms, scale metadata, missing-value treatments, or row limits.
acceptance_criteria: Capture the installed SmartPLS data-input and missing-data behavior in a versioned fixture before asserting exact parity for this dimension.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page explains weighted component construction but does not state the live application's data scaling or missing-value preprocessing sequence.
acceptance_criteria: Record the current scaling, centering, missing-value, and indicator-orientation behavior in a live-app matrix and test it end to end.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: GSCA assessment includes component weights, structural path coefficients, FIT, adjusted FIT, GFI, and bootstrap significance results.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result contains weights, paths, FIT, AFIT, GFI, and bootstrap inference with stable table identifiers.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page does not enumerate the charts, display defaults, or exportable chart data in the desktop results report.
acceptance_criteria: Capture the installed result-chart inventory and bind each observed chart and default to an export/readback fixture.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page does not specify typed handling for nonconvergence, degenerate composites, collinearity, invalid weights, or failed bootstrap fits.
acceptance_criteria: Build an adversarial live-app ledger for each condition and require QuickPLS to return a qualified result or a specific failure.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: The GSCA workflow specifies the model, estimates weights with ALS, assesses global fit and paths, and interprets structural and measurement results, with bootstrapping for significance.
acceptance_criteria: A complete workflow fixture runs specification, ALS estimation, fit and path assessment, bootstrap inference, save/reopen, and export.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS exposes test type, significance level, maximum Newton-Raphson iterations, and a log-likelihood-change stop criterion.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe and Run Details preserve test tail, alpha, iteration limit, and convergence tolerance exactly.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page names the controls and shows an example tolerance but does not freeze every current desktop default.
acceptance_criteria: Capture a fresh installed SmartPLS setup for test type, alpha, iteration limit, stop criterion, intercept, and classification cutoff before claiming default parity.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Logistic regression requires one binary outcome, one or more predictors, and an optional graphically specified intercept; multicategory predictors require contrasts such as dummy variables.
acceptance_criteria: Model fixtures cover binary coding, multiple metric and dummy-coded predictors, and otherwise identical models with and without an intercept.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: The dependent variable has exactly two categories, while predictors may be metric or categorical after appropriate contrast coding.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight rejects a non-binary outcome and accepts metric and valid contrast-coded predictors with explicit focal-class coding.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Categorical predictors with more than two categories must be converted to appropriate contrasts, such as dummy variables, before estimation.
acceptance_criteria: The data workflow creates reproducible dummy variables with an explicit reference category and preserves their lineage into the run.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Results include convergence, coefficients, standard errors, z and Wald statistics, p values, odds ratios, likelihood fit measures, pseudo R-squares, predicted probabilities, classes, confusion matrix, classification metrics, and AUC.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result exposes every documented result family and retains observation-level probabilities and predicted classes.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS provides a cutoff chart for accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and precision across thresholds, plus an ROC curve and AUC.
acceptance_criteria: Chart data reproduce the documented threshold metrics and ROC coordinates and remain semantically identical after export/readback.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Maximum-iteration nonconvergence, exact predictor collinearity, insufficient outcome-category information, and unstable data patterns require investigation before interpretation.
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial fixtures produce typed failures for a constant or non-binary outcome, perfect collinearity, separation or insufficient class information, and exhausted iterations.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: The recommended workflow verifies convergence, evaluates likelihood fit and coefficients, inspects predictions and classification, examines cutoff behavior and ROC/AUC, then validates predictive performance out of sample when prediction is claimed.
acceptance_criteria: A saved workflow fixture follows the documented sequence and keeps in-sample metrics clearly distinct from out-of-sample validation.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS exposes unstandardized, mean-centered, and standardized data metrics and a control-variable option for path analysis and PROCESS.
acceptance_criteria: The setup records the chosen data metric and control-variable semantics and applies them consistently to every equation.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page does not freeze the default data metric, control setting, or exact current catalogue of PROCESS templates.
acceptance_criteria: Capture a fresh installed setup and template inventory before asserting the default selection or complete template-number parity.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Path analysis estimates systems with multiple observed dependent and independent variables; PROCESS covers mediation, moderation, and moderated mediation, with controls where declared.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover multiple equations, mediation, moderation, moderated mediation, multiple outcomes, and declared controls.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Variables may be single-item observed constructs, while multi-indicator constructs are composed automatically with equal indicator weights.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures verify single observed variables and equal-weight multi-indicator scores without invoking iterative PLS weighting.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Unstandardized data are unchanged, mean-centered data subtract the mean, and standardized data subtract the mean and divide by the standard deviation.
acceptance_criteria: Microcases verify all three transformations and the exact operation order used before score construction and interaction calculation.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS automatically generates PROCESS path models and returns mediation, moderation, and moderated-mediation results without external calculations.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result includes equation coefficients and the applicable direct, indirect, conditional, and interaction results for each supported template.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page shows a model example but does not enumerate conditional-effect plots, confidence bands, display defaults, or export behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Capture the installed chart inventory for representative mediation, moderation, and moderated-mediation templates and bind it to visual/export fixtures.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page does not specify the exact template limits, invalid graph conditions, missing-data behavior, or typed calculation failures.
acceptance_criteria: Record unsupported template and graph combinations plus missing, zero-variance, collinearity, and singular-equation behavior in an adversarial ledger.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS provides one-step, regression-based path analysis on unstandardized data and automatically generates PROCESS models and their results.
acceptance_criteria: A workflow fixture selects a PROCESS form, generates its graph, calculates it, verifies the generated equations, and preserves the run through save/reopen and export.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS exposes subsamples, parallel processing, percentile, studentized, and BCa confidence intervals, test type, and significance level for PROCESS bootstrapping.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe preserves all documented controls and the runner uses the selected interval method, tail, alpha, and processor policy.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Percentile bootstrapping is the SmartPLS default and recommended general confidence-interval method.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh setup selects percentile intervals; the exact installed defaults for all remaining controls are retained as live-app evidence obligations.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: The procedure repeatedly re-estimates the specified path-analysis or PROCESS model and tests its coefficients.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures bootstrap mediation, moderation, and moderated-mediation coefficients using the same graph and preprocessing as the point estimate.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Each bootstrap sample draws observations with replacement and has the original analysis-sample size, reduced when case-by-case missing-data deletion reduced that sample.
acceptance_criteria: The resample ledger records source-row indices and exactly matches the effective analysis sample size for every replicate.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Bootstrap observations are sampled randomly with replacement before the path or PROCESS model is re-estimated.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic microcase verifies replacement, replicate counts, data-metric preprocessing, and fixed-seed repeatability.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Bootstrap estimates provide standard errors, t values, and 95% confidence intervals for significance testing.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result reports original estimates, bootstrap uncertainty, tests, intervals, requested parameter families, and the complete replicate/failure ledger.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page does not enumerate bootstrap histograms, conditional-effect charts, confidence bands, or their display defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Capture the installed results-chart inventory for representative PROCESS templates and bind each chart to canonical data and export fixtures.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page does not define how failed resamples, cancellation, invalid intervals, or partial result commitment appear.
acceptance_criteria: Capture installed failure behavior and require QuickPLS to retain every failed fit, cancel atomically, and never silently retry or commit partial results.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS suggests a smaller initial bootstrap such as 1,000 samples and a large final run such as 10,000, with parallel processing affecting speed rather than statistical logic.
acceptance_criteria: A workflow fixture supports initial and final runs, deterministic seed replay, worker-count invariance, progress, cancellation, save/reopen, and export.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS exposes one- or two-sided tests, significance level, and HC0, HC3, or HC4 standard-error types.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe and Run Details preserve test tail, alpha, and standard-error estimator, and inference tables identify the estimator used.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Normal HC0 standard errors are the SmartPLS default, while HC3 and HC4 are leverage-adjusted alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh setup selects HC0; exact installed defaults for test tail and alpha remain bound to a live-app defaults fixture before parity is asserted.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS supports simple and multiple linear regression with one metric dependent variable, one or more predictors, and an optional graphically specified intercept.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover one and several predictors plus otherwise identical models with and without the intercept.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page defines the regression roles but does not freeze accepted raw or matrix input forms, categorical coding, weights, or missing-data policies.
acceptance_criteria: Capture the installed data-input, scale, missing-value, and weight compatibility matrix before claiming exact input parity.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page reports standardized and unstandardized coefficients but does not freeze the live application's centering, scaling, categorical-preparation, or missing-data sequence.
acceptance_criteria: Record the installed preprocessing sequence in deterministic fixtures and preserve each transformation in dataset lineage.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: The report includes summary and ANOVA results, unstandardized and standardized coefficients, R-square and adjusted R-square, VIF and condition index, residual diagnostics, predicted values, Breusch-Pagan, descriptives, covariance/correlation, and integrated IPMA.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result exposes every documented result family with stable tables and observation-level fitted values and residuals.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS provides predicted-versus-residual, predicted-versus-actual, residual-autocorrelation, QQ, residual-histogram, and regression-IPMA charts.
acceptance_criteria: Each documented chart is generated from canonical data, has accessible non-colour semantics, and round-trips through supported exports.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The page explains collinearity, heteroscedasticity, residual assumptions, and leverage concerns but does not specify exact blocking thresholds or typed solver failures.
acceptance_criteria: Create adversarial fixtures for rank deficiency, zero variance, insufficient residual degrees of freedom, extreme leverage, invalid weights, and missing-data exhaustion.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: The evaluation workflow inspects coefficients and inference, explained variance and ANOVA, collinearity, residual diagnostics and heteroscedasticity, predictions, and integrated IPMA.
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end fixture follows the documented order and preserves model, data, settings, diagnostics, charts, and exports.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS exposes samples, amount of results, percentile, studentized, or BCa intervals, test type, significance level, random or fixed seed, and parallel processing.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe and Run Details preserve every documented setting and the result schema distinguishes important from complete output.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Percentile bootstrap is the default; the page recommends smaller initial runs such as 1,000 and large final runs such as 10,000.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh setup selects percentile intervals; a versioned live-app fixture records the exact installed defaults for all remaining controls.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Regression bootstrapping repeatedly re-estimates the same linear regression model and is distinct from maximum-likelihood logistic regression.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover simple and multiple metric-outcome regressions with identical point-estimate and bootstrap model semantics.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Each bootstrap sample contains the original analysis-sample size, or the reduced size after case-by-case missing-data deletion.
acceptance_criteria: The resample ledger records effective source-row indices, exclusions, and an exact sample count for every replicate.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Observations are drawn with replacement and the same regression model is re-estimated across samples.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic microcase verifies with-replacement indices, preprocessing reuse, fixed-seed replay, and worker-count invariance.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS reports original estimate, bootstrap mean, bootstrap standard error, t and p values, confidence intervals, and optional summaries for R-square, adjusted R-square, and VIF for unstandardized and standardized results.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result includes every requested parameter and quality family, confidence interval, bias information, and the complete replicate/failure ledger.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS provides empirical bootstrap histograms for unstandardized and standardized coefficients with a normal-reference curve.
acceptance_criteria: Histogram bins and reference data round-trip semantically through the canonical result and all supported chart exports.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: The official page does not define failed-refit accounting, invalid intervals, cancellation, memory exhaustion, or partial-result behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Capture installed behavior and require every failed refit to remain in the ledger, cancellation to be atomic, and no failed sample to be silently replaced.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: The workflow selects Regression Bootstrapping after specifying a linear model, uses smaller initial and large final sample counts, and can fix the seed for exact repetition; parallel processing changes speed rather than logic.
acceptance_criteria: A workflow fixture covers initial and final runs, deterministic replay, worker-count invariance, progress, cancellation, save/reopen, and export/readback.
